learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge and skills about the different methods and processes of production-manufacturing.
Know and understand the different material forming processes to achieve the desired product.
Know the different forming procedures for metals and alloys, as well as their interrelation between quality and costs.
Know the fundamental concepts of molding processes: casting and sintering.
Know the most modern forming techniques: by deformation, welding, cutting, machining, molding and others in the mechanical industry.
Know the fundamental concepts of the various industrial processes of plastic deformation of materials.
Acquire the fundamental concepts of welding metallurgy.
Aptitude for the distribution of resources and time and their implementation in real situations.
Ability to transmit concepts, ideas, processes, etc., related to Industrial Engineering orally and in writing, clearly and correctly.
Ability to use scientific-technical tools for solving calculation and design problems in Industrial Engineering and aptitude for finding sustainable engineering solutions.
Ability to work together and ability to develop multidisciplinary projects.
Ability to incorporate new knowledge in the area of Industrial Engineering, based on the acquired training and necessary for the evolution of technology.
Basic knowledge of production and manufacturing systems.

syllabus_topics: GENERAL ASPECTS OF MECHANICAL MANUFACTURING PROCESSES: Forming by molding. Forming by machining. Forming by welding. Forming by plastic deformation and cutting. Other forming procedures.
FORMING BY MOLDING: Sand casting; shell casting; Mercast; lost wax casting; CO2 casting and permanent mold casting. Powder metallurgy.
FORMING BY PLASTIC DEFORMATION: Forging. Stamping. Upsetting. Extrusion. Rolling. Drawing and Wire drawing. Sheet metal forming. Tube forming. Shearing. Punching. Bending and Curving. Deep drawing.
Production-Manufacturing Systems. Fundamentals of forming processes.
WELDING METALLURGY: Soft and hard soldering. Oxy-acetylene welding. Electric welding with normal and controlled atmospheres. Oxy-cutting.
teaching_methods: Large group activities (exposition, explanation, exemplification, lecture, problem-solving by the teacher)
Medium group activities (problem-solving and/or practical cases)
Seminars (specialized conferences/presentations with active student participation)
Evaluation tests (objective multiple-choice, short answer questions, practical and oral tests)

assessment_methods.method: Written exams of general knowledge and problem-solving

assessment_rules: The evaluation system will assess the acquisition of competencies, which must be demonstrated jointly through a continuous evaluation process and the progressive introduction of capabilities and skills throughout the course. The assessment criteria will be announced in each case.
